lemmas.primary_translation: to cut in line; figuratively, to gain advantages by bypassing normal procedures

definitions.text: gå foran andre i køen uten å vente på sin tur
definitions.translation: to go ahead of others in a queue without waiting for one's turn

definitions.text: i overført betydning: oppnå fordeler ved å ikke følge reglene for normal saksgang
definitions.translation: figuratively: to gain advantages by not following the rules for normal procedure

examples.no: prosjektet bør få snike i køen
examples.en: the project should be allowed to jump the queue
